<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="V5SRvqW_NebTCUz3Q_-N" name="Page-1"> <mxGraphModel dx="2854" dy="1523" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant Client
 participant API
 participant Redis
 participant MongoDB
 participant RabbitMQ
 participant Worker
 participant Provider

 Client->>API: POST /recipients
 API->>MongoDB: Save recipient
 API->>MongoDB: Save notification (pending, welcome email)
 API->>RabbitMQ: Publish message
 API-->>Client: 201 Created (recipient)

 Client->>API: POST /notifications
 API->>Redis: Rate limit check
 Redis-->>API: Allowed
 API->>MongoDB: Save notification (pending)
 API->>RabbitMQ: Publish message
 API->>MongoDB: Update status (queued)
 API-->>Client: 201 Created

 RabbitMQ->>Worker: Consume message
 Worker->>MongoDB: Update status (processing)
 Worker->>Provider: Send notification

 alt Success
 Provider-->>Worker: Delivered
 Worker->>MongoDB: status = sent, provider, latency
 else Failure (attempts < max)
 Provider-->>Worker: Error
 Worker->>Worker: Wait (exponential backoff)
 Worker->>RabbitMQ: Re-publish (attempt + 1)
 Worker->>MongoDB: status = queued
 RabbitMQ->>Worker: Consume message (retry)
 else Failure (max attempts reached)
 Provider-->>Worker: Error
 Worker->>MongoDB: status = failed, real error message
 end
",
 "config": null
